data.name: Eudoca
data.gender_notes: Eudoca is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word eu (good) and docē (to teach, to learn). In ancient Greece, Eudoca symbolized a good and virtuous woman who was a blessing to her family and community. The name Eudoca carries the meaning “Good gift, blessing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eudoca usually hope their child will grow to embody good gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a gift from God, one who brings blessings and teaches valuable lessons.
data.etymology: Eudoca belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good gift, blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eudoca total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: עוֹדוֹקָה
in_hebrew.meaning: בת שם טוב, פרח, ילדה אור, קדושה, נאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עוֹדוֹקָה היא שם שמעודןו, קדוש, נאה. בת שם טוב. שם זה נמצא במקורות יהודיים. השם עוֹדוֹקָה, שהוא שם נשי, נכנס לשפה העברית, כבר בימי הבית השני. שם זה, הוא תעתיק לשם יווני, שמשמעותו 'פרח', 'בן של יופי'. במקורות יהודיים, השם נקשר עם פרח, ובהקשר זה, השם עוֹדוֹקָה, נחשב לשם הנאה, הקדוש, הנפלא.

in_greek.name: Εὐδοκα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Εὐδοκα (Εὐδοκα) είναι γυναικείος όρος, που προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις Ευδοκία και Ευδοκιμία. Ο όρος Εὐδοκα, σημαίνει καλή, ευτυχής, πλούσια, πλούσιος, και είναι ένα από τα πιο κοινά ονόματα στην ελληνική γλώσσα. Ο όρος Εὐδοκα, είναι επίσης, ένα από τα πιο κοινά ονόματα στην ελληνική γλώσσα, και είναι ένα από τα πιο ποπ ονόματα στην Ελλάδα. Ο όρος Εὐδοκα, έχει τις ρίζες του στην αρχαία ελληνική γλώσσα, και σημαίνει καλή, ευτυχής, πλούσια, πλούσιος.

in_latin.name: Eudoca
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eudoca significat bonum, felicitas, divitiae. In latino, Eudoca est nomen femininum, quod venit ab Eudocia et Eudocimia. Nomen Eudoca significat bene, felicitas, divitiae. Nomen Eudoca est commune in lingua Latina. In historia Ecclesiae, nomen Eudoca est appositum mulieribus, quae habebant virtutes bonae.

In Christian tradition, the name Eudoca is associated with virtues such as goodness, happiness, and prosperity. In modern times, the name Eudoca is used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing good fortune, happiness, and blessedness.
